jobs.title: Product Designer (UX), HCI
jobs.description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

Design how people use AI in real product workflows. This role focuses on building HCI interfaces where users can understand, guide, correct, and stay in control of AI systems that reason and act across multiple steps.

Current UX patterns are not enough for proactive AI products. You will help define new interaction models for how users work with AI, review progress, recover from mistakes, and build trust in the system.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design end-to-end user experiences for AI product surfaces, from concept to shipped product.

  • Create interaction patterns for human-AI workflows, including prompting, review, confirmation, correction, handoff, and recovery.

  • Design interfaces that help users understand what the AI is doing, what it knows, what it is unsure about, and what will happen next.

  • Turn complex, multi-step AI capabilities into flows that are clear, controllable, and usable in everyday contexts.

  • Work closely with product, engineering, and ML teams to define problems, test ideas, and ship quickly.

  • Produce wireframes, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile.

  • Run lightweight user research and usability tests to identify friction, trust issues, and failure points.

  • Help define reusable HCI design patterns as the product and design system mature.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a product designer or UX designer, with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

  • Strong skills in interaction design, information hierarchy, and prototyping.

  • Proficiency in Figma and fast iteration workflows.

  • Ability to simplify complex systems and turn unclear product behavior into clear user experiences.

  • Experience working closely with product managers and engineers in fast-moving teams.

  • Comfort working with ambiguity and shaping solutions before requirements are fully defined.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, and failure handling.

  • Clear thinking about trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven experiences.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Our Talent Acquisition Team is on a mission to seek out and build a talented team by finding new GetYourGuide stars who will contribute to our international growth. While looking for top talent, we have a candidate-centric approach to ensure a best-in-class recruitment experience for all our candidates and hiring managers. We are growing fast, and so is our demand for great talent across the business. We are looking for a passionate, people-focused and strategic Senior Business Recruiting Lead to join our People team and lead a team of 9: experienced Business Recruiters, Talent Operations Specialists and Sourcers.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll guide, mentor and scale a team that plays a critical part in shaping our future. You’ll own and be accountable for Business (non-tech) hiring end-to-end—acting as the primary partner to business leaders and the People team to build the talent plans and execution needed to support our growth. If you love driving hiring strategy, building strong stakeholder relationships and leading with empathy and data - this one’s for you.

Your mission

  • Lead and develop a team of 9 Business Recruiters, Talent Operations Specialists, and Sourcers—setting clear goals and success metrics, ensuring delivery against hiring targets, managing performance, and driving productivity, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the function.

  • Partner and build strong relationships with senior stakeholders (up to C Level) to define hiring priorities and deliver high-quality hires across all Business functions, including Marketing, Sales, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and People.

  • Collaborate closely with the wider People function (e.g., People Partners, Rewards, People Services) to build strong, trusted relationships and ensure seamless alignment across talent, people programs, and core people processes .

  • Set the strategic direction for your team, define the roadmap, and ensure alignment with overarching business goals

  • Monitor and optimize recruitment metrics (time to hire, pipeline conversions etc.) to drive performance and impact

  • Own and initiate key talent projects that level-up how we attract and engage quality talent

  • Be a true talent partner — advising, challenging, and bringing insights to help our leaders hire smarter and faster whilst maintaining our hiring bar

  • Stay ahead of industry trends and bring in fresh ideas, tools, and practices to keep us at the top of our game

Your toolkit

  • You have 5+ years of in-house Talent Acquisition experience across business and/or tech hiring, with a strong focus on business functions.

  • You have 2+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of developing and steering teams to deliver against core goals.

  • You’re data-savvy and can grasp various tools to make smart, strategic decisions

  • You have strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and consult senior stakeholders up to C-level

  • You’re happy to get hands-on when needed, especially when it comes to senior or strategic hires

  • You’re not afraid of the operational side of things — you stay on top of admin tasks like position management and you’re always looking for ways to improve processes

  • You work well in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment and keep things moving forward

  • You are a natural collaborator — whether it’s with the People team or business leaders, you bring others along and build trust across the board

Extras that give you an edge

  • You’re energized by AI: you make time to experiment, build intuition through hands-on trials, and translate discoveries into practical improvements in how you work

How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options

  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time. 

  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize  with a quarterly team event budget 

  • Access to leading AI tools plus the resources and budget to get the most out of them

  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget

  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

  • Language reimbursement program

  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘our culture’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist; it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

About the Role

Our team is growing, and we are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will own the full arc of our most strategic services engagements, from the first conversation about what AI could do for a customer's business, through the delivery that builds it, to the value they realise from it. You will scope and price the services that move an enterprise from AI ambition to AI running in production, support the sale of that work alongside the Account Owner, and orchestrate the consultants and engineers who deliver it. You will stay with the engagement well past the build, accountable for turning what the customer bought into AI that is genuinely doing their work.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our London office.

Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery with executives and process owners, then build the deployment strategy with them: which departments, workflows, and use cases move to intelligent, agent-driven execution on the monday AI work platform.

  • Translate that strategy into a scoped and priced services engagement, owning packaging, effort and unit estimation, and the proposals and statements of work that carry it.

  • Support the sale of services alongside the Account Owner, articulating the path from a customer's current state to AI in production for stakeholders from technical staff to executive sponsors.

  • Define the work clearly enough for someone else to build it, capturing the outcome, the estimate, and the shape of the solution, then bring in the forward deployed consultants and engineers who execute it.

  • Own timeline, budget, quality, risk, and commercial administration across your engagements, running one-time projects directly, overseeing execution on ongoing ones, and directing the resources assigned to you.

  • Define the work plan with customers on ongoing engagements, deciding together which AI use cases to build next and in what sequence.

  • Own AI value realisation inside your engagements, tracking consumption against the plan agreed at sale and diagnosing where adoption gaps or unbuilt workflows hold it back.

  • Identify and/or support the next outcome opportunity within your accounts, and drive the additional services needed to deliver it — expanding the engagement as new use cases and workflows are identified.

  • Communicate status, risk, and progress to stakeholders at every level, manage escalations to resolution, and surface account risk and expansion signals to the Account Owner.

  • Feed the practice from the field, contributing the patterns, estimation inputs, and playbooks that make each AI deployment faster than the last.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional services experience in delivery management, engagement management, or technical program management, with significant time in front of enterprise customers delivering successful strategic outcomes

  • Experience in B2B SaaS scoping and delivering software implementation, transformation, or managed services engagements in complex enterprise environments, working in industry-standard work management, project management, or CRM platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with Generative and Agentic AI tools, and a strong understanding of how AI changes the way work gets done.

  • Commercial acumen sufficient to scope, price, and support the sale of services rather than simply deliver them, including effort estimation and statement of work authorship.

  • Experience with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models, and with holding a customer to the value they set out to achieve, is a strong plus.

  • A track record of leading technical and non-technical delivery teams through influence, keeping the team aligned to a common goal.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to be credible in an architecture conversation and to recognise when an engagement needs deeper expertise: how enterprise systems exchange data, and when a goal calls for software to be built rather than configured.

  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills, able to establish credibility with executives, articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience, and frame business outcomes for a technical one.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies.

  • Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.

  • BA or BS degree preferred.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Director
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer (Orly)
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer to ensure that our suppliers are delivering at the right level of quality, in particular through audits and supplier development.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Conduct supplier qualification and approval (new sources, special processes).

  • Conduct supplier / process audits (AS9100, special-process, APQP).

  • Ensure FAI (AS9102) and PPAP review; receiving-inspection strategy and defect containment.

  • Implement supplier 8D / corrective actions, scorecards, and be the owner of the supplier development; NDAA / AQAP flow-down.

  • Collaboration and Communication

    • Work with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Engineering, and Supply Chain, using platforms such as Jira or Confluence to document and track quality topics related to design projects.

    • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers and regulatory bodies, on project quality status and resolutions.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Participate in initiatives to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the design and development processes, focusing on reducing design-related risks and ensuring first-time-right product realization.

    • Collect and analyze quality data from the design phase to support performance monitoring and reporting for project milestones.

Candidate Requirements

  • Engineering degree in quality, industrial, aeronautical, or mechanical engineering.

  • 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in supplier / procurement quality, preferably in the aerospace, defense, or automotive sectors.

  • Strong experience in Supplier audit & qualification, PPAP / FAI run, Supplier corrective action (8D)

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and departments in an international environment.

  • Open for supplier travel

  • Communication & Commitment: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; full alignment with Harmattan AI’s mission and willingness to go the extra mile to support our growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.description:
Trainee DevOps Engineer – Agile (m/w/d)

Standort: Bremen (Sebaldsbrück)

Start: Januar / Februar 2027

Warum ein Traineeprogramm mit SPECTRUM

Durch maßgeschneiderte Schulungen und praxisnahe Projektarbeit baust du im Rahmen des Programms fundierte Kompetenzen im agilen DevOps Engineering auf. Das Traineeprogramm ist darauf ausgerichtet, dir die Methoden, Werkzeuge und fachlichen Grundlagen zu vermitteln, die du benötigst, um die Softwareentwicklung in einem hochkomplexen, hardwarenahen Umfeld effizienter zu gestalten.
Ab dem ersten Tag steht dir ein erfahrener Mentor zur Seite, der dich fachlich begleitet und individuell unterstützt. Freue dich auf ein dynamisches Team, das dich von Beginn an bei deinem Einstieg mit viel Engagement und positiver Energie unterstützt.

Unternehmensprofil

Du wirst Teil eines international führenden Unternehmens im Bereich maritimer Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitstechnologien. Als Spezialist für hochkomplexe Sensor-, Führungs- und Waffeneinsatzsysteme arbeitet das High-Tech-Unternehmen weltweit mit Marinekunden und Industriepartnern zusammen.
Mit Standorten in Deutschland und internationalen Projekten bietet das Unternehmen von Beginn an die Möglichkeit, in interdisziplinären Teams an technologisch anspruchsvollen Lösungen zu arbeiten, die sicherheitsrelevante Missionen auf See ermöglichen.
Der Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung, Integration und dem Betrieb innovativer Systeme für Unterwasser-, Überwasser- und Führungsanwendungen mit höchsten Anforderungen an Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und technologische Exzellenz.

Beschreibung der Abteilung und des Tätigkeitsbereichs

Die DevOps-Abteilung verantwortet die zentrale CI/CD-Infrastruktur und unterstützt die Softwareentwicklungsteams bei deren Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung.
Die Abteilung ist in zwei spezialisierte Bereiche gegliedert: das Core Team (Platform) und das Enablement Team (Agile DevOps).
Als Agile DevOps Engineer arbeitest du direkt im Softwareentwicklungsteam und fungierst als Brückenbauer zwischen DevOps-Methodik und der täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit. Das technische Umfeld ist hauptsächlich Embedded-geprägt mit C++ als Hauptsprache, Betriebssystemen wie Linux, sowie einer Infrastruktur im regulierten Defense-Umfeld.
Die Auswahl des konkreten Entwicklungsteams erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung deiner fachlichen Stärken, Interessen und Entwicklungsperspektiven.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung, Support, Durchsicht, (Weiter-)Entwicklung und Überarbeitung der spezifischen CI/CD-Pipelines im Verantwortungsbereich (Projekt, Domäne, Team)
  • Unterstützung in der Testautomatisierung und Aufbau von Testpipelines
  • Durchführung der Software-Integrationsarbeit (SW|SW Integration) im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich
  • Support der Entwickler und Hilfestellung im Umgang mit DevOps-Tools und -Methoden
  • Befähigung der Entwickler zur Nutzung der Plattform und der Tools, Services und Methoden (z. B. CLion, CMake, GitLab, Gitflow)
  • Systemadministration des jeweiligen System- bzw. Produktanteils auf Basis eines definierten Workflows im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich
  • Kontinuierliche Optimierung der DevOps-Methoden und Behebung von Fehlern in den DevOps-Tools des Entwicklungsteams
  • Erstellung und Pflege teamspezifischer DevOps-Dokumentation, orientiert an DevOps Guidelines und Best Practices
  • Erstellung, Support und Verantwortung spezifischer Container-Templates im Verantwortungsbereich
  • Release Management im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich
  • Sicherstellung von Standards in Methoden und Skripten über die Entwicklerteams hinweg

Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Technischer Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Elektrotechnik mit Informatik-Schwerpunkt oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Grundkenntnisse in Git/GitLab
  • Linux-Grundkenntnisse
  • Kenntnisse in C/C++
  • Grundverständnis von Netzwerken und Betriebssystemen
  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an CI/CD, Automatisierung und modernen Entwicklungsprozessen
  • Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Entwickler für DevOps-Themen zu begeistern und mitzureißen
  • Teamfähigkeit und hohe Eigenmotivation
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliches und sehr attraktives Gehalt
  • 35-Stunden-Woche, 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Dir bietet sich eine strukturierte Entwicklungsperspektive, die dich zum Experten im Bereich DevOps Engineering und CI/CD-Integration macht
  • Arbeiten in einem innovativen, internationalen Umfeld und an hochmodernen High-Tech-Produkten
  • Im Traineeprogramm profitierst du von der idealen Kombination aus Praxisphasen und speziell auf dich zugeschnittenen Schulungen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten

Kontakt

jobs.title: Staff Systems Administrator (R5995)
jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a highly autonomous Staff Systems Administrator to serve as the accountable technical owner for enterprise IT infrastructure and end-user computing within a dedicated, security-sensitive entity environment. This senior individual contributor will design, implement, operate, secure, and continuously improve on-premises systems, cloud platforms, identity services, networks, and endpoints while preserving required legal, operational, information-security, and access boundaries.

The role combines deep infrastructure ownership with hands-on service delivery. The successful candidate will translate security and compliance requirements into durable technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, drive equipment and endpoint hardening, and deliver resilient support to engineering and business teams with minimal oversight.

What you'll do:

  • Infrastructure Ownership (On-Prem & Cloud)

    • Own and operate on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup platforms, identity services, core network services, and enterprise applications.

    • Administer Azure and/or AWS environments with responsibility for availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, secure configuration, backup, and disaster-recovery readiness.

    • Define technical roadmaps, identify operational risks, and independently drive modernization, standardization, scalability, and resilience improvements.

    • Maintain accurate architecture diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, recovery documentation, configuration records, and service ownership information.

    • Plan and execute infrastructure changes using disciplined change, testing, rollback, and post-implementation review practices.

    Firewalled Entity and Segmented-Environment Support

    • Operate technology services for a dedicated legal or operating entity with explicit separation of systems, identities, data, administration, suppliers, and access from other corporate environments where required.

    • Implement and maintain approved trust boundaries, network segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote access, administrative tiers, and controlled cross-entity connectivity.

    • Ensure data, devices, accounts, cloud resources, and third-party access remain within authorized entity, contractual, regulatory, and data-residency boundaries.

    • Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and corporate IT teams to translate entity-specific obligations into practical controls, operating procedures, and evidence.

    • Document and periodically validate boundary controls, data flows, privileged access paths, exceptions, and intercompany dependencies; escalate gaps and drive remediation to closure.

    • Support local business continuity and operational autonomy while aligning with approved global architecture, security standards, and governance.

    Security, Compliance, and Systems

    • Establish, implement, and maintain secure configuration baselines for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, network devices, cloud services, and endpoint-management platforms using recognized frameworks and vendor guidance.

    • Own patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows, including asset coverage, risk-based prioritization, remediation timelines, exception documentation, validation, and status reporting.

    • Administer and validate endpoint protections such as full-disk encryption, EDR/XDR, host firewall, secure boot, application controls, device compliance, removable-media controls, and least-privilege configurations.

    • Harden identity and administrative access through role-based access control, multifactor authentication, privileged-access separation, conditional access, service-account governance, and periodic access reviews.

    • Maintain logging, alerting, time synchronization, configuration monitoring, backup protection, and security telemetry needed for detection, investigation, and auditability.

    • Collect and maintain audit-ready evidence; support internal and external audits, control assessments, security reviews, customer requirements, and remediation plans.

    • Participate in incident response, containment, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for infrastructure and endpoint security events.

    • Manage technical risks and policy exceptions transparently, including compensating controls, accountable owners, expiration dates, and closure plans.

    Identity, Endpoint, and Service Delivery

    • Administer Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms, including user and group lifecycle, authentication, authorization, federation, and policy enforcement.

    • Manage Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints through Intune, Jamf, or equivalent tooling, ensuring secure provisioning, configuration compliance, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and timely retirement.

    • Lead onboarding and offboarding activities, including device provisioning, access configuration, license assignment, asset recovery, and compliance validation.

    • Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for employees, engineering systems, lab environments, collaboration services, and secure connectivity.

    • Own IT asset lifecycle, software licensing, vendor coordination, procurement support, warranty management, and secure equipment disposal.

    • Use scripting and automation to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and provide meaningful operational and compliance reporting.

    • Contribute reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, and documentation that can scale across comparable international entity environments.

Required qualifications:

  • 8 + years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, enterprise IT operations, or a closely related discipline.

  • Demonstrated success independently owning production IT infrastructure and end-user environments in a complex, regulated, segmented, or security-sensitive organization.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Windows, macOS, and Linux; server administration and virtualization; Azure and/or AWS; and Active Directory and Entra ID or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Practical experience implementing system and endpoint hardening, configuration baselines, patch management, vulnerability remediation, encryption, endpoint detection and response, and least-privilege controls.

  • Experience supporting security or compliance programs and producing evidence for audits, assessments, or customer and regulatory requirements.

  • Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, network segmentation, firewall policy, and secure remote access.

  • Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Intune, Jamf, or equivalent, including compliance policy and device lifecycle management.

  • Experience implementing and testing monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and business-continuity capabilities.

  • Excellent documentation, prioritization, risk communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive outcomes under limited supervision.

  • Ability to support time-sensitive operational needs and participate in planned after-hours maintenance or incident response when required.

About the Role

As Director, Fraud, you will lead Airwallex’s First Line of Defence (1LoD) Fraud function. You will own the design, execution, and continuous optimization of our global fraud strategy, policies, detection systems, and operational workflows across Airwallex’s financial infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for stopping fraud in real time while keeping friction low for legitimate, high-growth global businesses. Airwallex processes billions in cross-border payments, multi-currency corporate cards, merchant acquiring, and embedded finance products. You and your team will directly defend our ecosystem against card fraud, account takeover (ATO), merchant bust-out, payment scams, and synthetic identities.

You will partner directly with Engineering, Data Science, Product, Legal, and Compliance and interface closely with Second Line Risk to build and operate scalable, AI-native fraud detection models, effective triaging processes and operational guardrails.

What You’ll Do

  • Define & Execute 1LoD Global Fraud Strategy: Direct and build out the operational fraud strategy across all Airwallex products (Global Accounts, FX, Acquiring, Cards, and Embedded Finance / BaaS). Translate enterprise risk appetite set by the board and 2LoD Risk into actionable rules, detection logic, operational policies, and loss-prevention workflows.

  • Lead & Scale the 1LoD Fraud Team: Build, lead, and mentor a world-class team of fraud strategists, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for rule writing, alert triage, incident response, and dispute operations.

  • Optimize Risk vs. Conversion: Own and execute real-time fraud decisioning rules, loss-mitigation frameworks, and chargeback monitoring programs. Drive precision in risk controls to reduce fraud losses without introducing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

  • Drive Product & AI/ML Execution: Co-own the fraud product roadmap with Data Science and ML Engineering teams. Directly inform and test next-generation models for real-time transaction monitoring, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, and anomaly detection.

  • Incident Management & Root Cause Remediation: Lead real-time response to complex or high-value fraud incidents. Conduct post-mortems, deploy immediate policy/rule fixes, and implement long-term structural remediations.

  • Metrics & Loss Budget Ownership: Own operational KPIs, fraud loss performance against targets, False Positive Rates (FPR), triage SLAs, and chargeback recovery rates. Serve as the primary operational presenter on 1LoD performance to risk committees and leadership.

Essentials

jobs.title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.
  • Fluent German and English.


Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing.

Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA.

Why you should work at Famedly:

  • Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector.
  • Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments.
  • Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape.
  • Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths.
  • Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens.
  • Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space!
  • Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year.
  • Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club.
  • A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome.
  • Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit.


We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you!

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.

With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

 
 

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

How fast can we grow, where should we invest, and what needs to change when performance moves off plan? As Senior FP&A Manager, you will help plancraft answer these questions as we scale across Europe.

You will build the financial view that connects our growth ambitions to what is happening in the business. Working directly with leadership, country teams, and budget owners, you will challenge assumptions, uncover what drives performance, and turn your analysis into recommendations that shape where we put our resources.

There is plenty to build along the way. You will co-own planning, forecasting, and management reporting, make Abacum a live working tool for the business, and use AI and automation to get from data to useful insights faster. Working closely with our Director of Finance and another FP&A Manager, you will have the scope to shape how FP&A operates and make it a function people turn to when they need to make a decision.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own planning and forecasting: Lead annual financial planning, budgeting, monthly forecasting, and quarterly reviews. Connect leadership’s ambitions with realistic assumptions and inputs from across the business.

  • Explain performance and recommend action: Analyse actuals against budget and forecast, investigate variances at account and cost centre level, and translate your findings into clear recommendations.

  • Build visibility across markets: Own country P&Ls and the planning and reporting structures behind them, helping stakeholders understand performance as we expand.

  • Make Abacum the place where planning happens: Own and develop our live planning model, keep it connected to reliable actuals, and make it useful for leadership and budget owners in their daily work.

  • Deliver reporting people can act on: Prepare the monthly management pack and board and investor reporting. Bring together financial performance, business drivers, and SaaS metrics such as CAC, payback, and LTV into a clear story.

  • Partner with the business: Work with budget owners on planning inputs, spending, and performance. Challenge assumptions constructively and raise risks and opportunities early.

  • Automate recurring work: Use AI and automation to improve data preparation, reporting, and planning workflows, with clear checks that keep outputs accurate and explainable.

  • Support the wider Finance agenda: Work with the Director of Finance on projects, implementations, and the financial analysis behind funding rounds. Partner with Accounting and Finance Operations on reconciliations, data quality, and audit readiness.

Your Profile

  • Exceptional communication and business partnering: You communicate clearly and confidently in English with leadership and budget owners. You make complex financial topics easy to understand, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn insights into practical recommendations. You enjoy working closely with people across the business. Communication is a significant part of this role.

  • Strong FP&A ownership: You bring extensive FP&A experience (5+ years) and have independently run planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, and can explain how your analysis informed business decisions.

  • Hands-on modelling skills: You build and maintain financial models and reports yourself, understand their underlying assumptions, and can connect operational drivers to financial outcomes.

  • SaaS, software, or tech experience: You understand the economics of a software business and can interpret the metrics that matter for its growth and performance.

  • Planning system ownership: You have owned a platform such as Abacum or a comparable planning tool, including developing models, improving workflows, and enabling stakeholders to use it.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You actively look for ways to improve recurring work and can judge where automation adds value and where human review is needed.

  • A broad Finance foundation: You understand how accounting, tax, and financial operations affect planning and reporting, and work effectively with specialists across these areas.

  • Proactive, reliable execution: You take ownership of deadlines, bring updates without being asked, and stay clear and organised when priorities compete. You are fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to board reporting or fundraising support.

  • Familiarity with Abacum, BigQuery, or connecting planning tools to accounting and operational data.

  • Another European language.

Who this role is for

You have seen what good FP&A looks like, and you are ready to build it in a business that is scaling fast. You enjoy creating the model, getting close to the business, and turning incomplete information into a recommendation people can act on.

You are comfortable taking ownership before everything is neatly defined. When inputs are missing, you bring the right people together. When assumptions do not hold up, you challenge them. When a process slows everyone down, you improve it. You can deliver the next forecast while building a better way to run the one after it.

At plancraft, that means shaping planning across growing European markets, making Abacum useful for budget owners, and putting AI and automation to work in everyday Finance. You will have room to make decisions, test better approaches, and see your work influence how we grow. That freedom comes with the expectation that you move things forward, communicate proactively, and follow through.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own our customer deployments end to end. Our system runs on-prem at industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, and military sites, integrated with the cameras, networks, and robots already in place. You survey the site, plan the deployment, install and integrate the system, tune it to the site's conditions, and hand it over to operators who will rely on it daily.

You are also the technical face of Laelaps on site. You work with security operators to understand how they actually work and where the bottlenecks are, align with their leadership on what success looks like, and translate what you learn into configuration, code, and product priorities. Early deployments you run alongside the founders; over time you own sites and accounts independently.

Expect roughly half your time at customer sites in Switzerland and Europe, and the rest in Zurich, turning field lessons into tooling and automation that make each deployment faster than the last. This is an engineering role with a customer in the room, not a support or services role.

What You'll Work On

  • Deployments end-to-end: site surveys, network and hardware planning, installation, camera and VMS integration, commissioning, validation, and handover.

  • On-prem infrastructure: install and manage our stack on edge hardware (NVIDIA DGX Spark, Jetson Thor class devices) inside customer networks, often air-gapped or heavily restricted.

  • Integrations: connect existing cameras, sensors, VMS platforms, and robots into one coordinated system, and write the glue code where no integration exists yet.

  • System tuning: calibrate detection and tracking to each site's terrain, lighting, and threat profile until the system performs in the field as it does in the demo.

  • Pilots to production: make POCs succeed technically, because pilots that work become contracts.

  • Customer understanding: sit with operators, interview stakeholders from the control room to the leadership floor, and map the real problems and bottlenecks behind the stated requirements.

  • Customer trust: train operators, respond fast when something breaks, and be the engineer customers ask for by name.

  • The deployment playbook: turn every hard-won lesson into runbooks, tooling, and automation that compound.

  • Product feedback: bring real field signal back to the core engineering team and shape the roadmap with it.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for an engineer who runs toward the messy parts, with the EQ to match the IQ. You are as comfortable in a server room or on a windswept perimeter as you are in a terminal, and just as comfortable in a conversation. You can spend a shift with a security operator and earn enough trust that they tell you what actually goes wrong at 3 a.m., then brief a head of security or a site director in their language, not yours. You listen more than you pitch, you read the room, and you switch registers between the guard house and the boardroom without breaking stride. You debug across the whole stack without ceremony: is it the hardware, the network, the driver, the model, or the config? Above all, you take personal ownership of the outcome: the deployment works because you made it work, and the customer trusts us because you earned it.

Your Background

  • 3+ years of relevant software, robotics, embedded systems, or systems integration experience.

  • A Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong Python and hands-on C++ experience. You can read, debug, and extend production code in both.

  • Experience deploying and operating software on-prem or at the edge (Docker required; GPU inference experience a strong plus).

  • Experience working with sensors and embedded systems, including device interfaces and communications protocols.

  • High EQ and experience working directly with end users or customers: you can uncover needs, work across stakeholders, and communicate technical issues clearly.

  • Composure in customer-facing technical sessions, including when systems fail and plans need to change.

  • Fluent German and/or French, and good English. Our sites and their operators run in German; the team runs in English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customer sites across Switzerland and Europe, with multi-day on-site stints.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich.

  • Citizenship of Switzerland, an EU/EFTA member state, or a NATO member state, and eligibility for security clearance where customer sites require it.

  • A valid category B driving license.

Nice to Have

  • Real networking competence: VLANs, firewalls, routing, VPNs, and debugging connectivity in networks you do not control.

  • Hands-on comfort with hardware: you have racked servers, flashed devices, crimped a cable, or built systems that touch the physical world. Checking cable connections at 2 a.m. at a client site is second nature while debugging an issue on a customer side.

  • Experience with cameras, VMS platforms (Milestone, Genetec, or similar), ONVIF/RTSP, or the physical security industry.

  • Computer vision or ML deployment experience, especially optimising inference on edge GPUs.

  • Robotics experience: ROS2 and Rviz2, robot integration, or fleet operations.

  • Experience in defence, government, or other regulated environments.

  • French, Italian, or another European language.

  • Startup experience, ideally somewhere you were handed a hard problem and a deadline instead of a spec.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Embed on-site with enterprise customers for focused 5-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place.

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30-50% of the time for on-site engagements, primarily across Europe.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

jobs.description:
Customer Success Operations & Business Analyst (H/F)

Stage de 6 mois – à partir de janvier 2027
Localisation : Paris

Prêt(e) à rejoindre la révolution Legal Tech ?

DiliTrust est un éditeur SaaS mondial qui transforme les directions juridiques grâce à une technologie de pointe.
En rejoignant nos équipes, vous intégrerez une scale-up SaaS en forte croissance, avec l’ambition de devenir une future licorne de la LegalTech. Vous travaillerez au cœur du business, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Customer Success, Sales et la direction, et contribuerez directement à des décisions structurantes pour l’organisation.

Vision

En tant que fournisseur de logiciels SaaS, DiliTrust est une entreprise mondiale dédiée à offrir une suite intégrée de solutions juridiques et de gouvernance. Notre vision est de digitaliser les directions juridiques à travers le monde et de devenir un leader mondial de la Legal Tech.

Notre impact

De la génération de rapports d’assemblées générales à la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats assistée par l’intelligence artificielle, nos équipes contribuent chaque jour au succès de DiliTrust et à la satisfaction de ses clients dans un contexte international.

Notre reconnaissance

DiliTrust est à l’avant-garde de l’innovation en Legal Tech et s’attache à offrir un environnement de travail positif, entrepreneurial et stimulant.

Le rôle

Au sein de l’équipe Customer Success, vous contribuerez à structurer et à améliorer les opérations de l’équipe grâce à l’analyse de données, à la fiabilisation du CRM et à la mise en place d’outils de pilotage.
Votre mission sera de donner davantage de visibilité à l’équipe sur la performance et la santé du portefeuille clients, tout en participant à la construction de l’organisation Customer Success de demain. Les analyses, tableaux de bord et processus que vous développerez auront un impact direct sur les décisions de l’équipe et sur le suivi de nos clients.

Missions

1. Construire l’organisation de demain

  • Participer aux analyses relatives à l’organisation 2027 de l’équipe Customer Success et formuler des recommandations à partir des données disponibles.
  • Contribuer à la refonte du score de santé client et préparer les supports des comités avec la direction Customer Success.

2. Donner de la visibilité à toute l’équipe

  • Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord HubSpot permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés de l’activité : rétention, croissance, activité et performance du portefeuille.
  • Préparer les chiffres clés des rituels d’équipe et des revues de performance, et construire des business reviews clients percutantes, de l’analyse des données jusqu’à la préparation des supports.

3. Rendre notre CRM fiable et utile

  • Contribuer à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données HubSpot : comptes, propriétaires, fiches entreprises et informations relatives au suivi client.
  • Participer au regroupement des outils de suivi client dans HubSpot et travailler avec les équipes Sales afin de fluidifier le passage de relais ainsi que le suivi des renouvellements.

4. Simplifier et automatiser

  • Rédiger des modes opératoires clairs et accessibles afin d’harmoniser les pratiques de l’équipe au quotidien.
  • Contribuer à l’automatisation du suivi d’une partie du portefeuille client, identifier les possibilités de simplification et proposer des améliorations concrètes.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes actuellement étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d’ingénieurs, en université ou dans une formation spécialisée en business analytics, gestion de projet, stratégie, opérations ou relation client.
Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027 et vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement SaaS, international et en forte croissance.
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
  • Votre esprit analytique et votre capacité à transformer des données en recommandations concrètes.
  • Votre rigueur et votre attention portée à la qualité des informations.
  • Votre capacité à structurer des sujets complexes et à les présenter de manière claire et synthétique.
  • Votre autonomie, votre sens de l’initiative et votre capacité à proposer des améliorations.
  • Votre aisance relationnelle et votre goût du travail en équipe, notamment avec des interlocuteurs Customer Success, Sales et Direction.

Connaissances techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d’Excel ou de Google Sheets : analyse de données, recherche d’informations, tableaux croisés dynamiques et mise en forme de données.
  • Intérêt marqué pour les CRM et les outils de pilotage de la performance.
  • Une première expérience avec HubSpot ou un autre CRM serait un plus.
  • La connaissance des principes de création de tableaux de bord, d’automatisation et de qualité des données serait appréciée.
  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais professionnel.

Process

  • Entretien avec un membre de l’équipe Talent Acquisition.
  • Entretien avec le/la manager.
  • Entretien technique ou étude de cas pratique.
